templates.name: AI chat stream
templates.summary: A chat set like a printed interview: the prompt rises, dots think, and the reply streams in word by word.
templates.agentHint: Show an AI feature answering. Prompt under ~60 characters, reply under ~200 (about 30 words; longer replies stream too fast to read). Speaker labels are SPEAKERS in the file.

params.name: Prompt
params.default: Write a launch post for our new planner

params.name: Reply
params.default: Meet the planner your team will actually open. Northwind turns scattered tasks into one calm week, so you spend less time planning and more time shipping.

templates.name: AI chat stream
templates.summary: A prompt types into the glass pill, the pill rises into a chat window as the user message, and the reply streams in with a teal caret.
templates.agentHint: Show an AI feature answering. Prompt one line (under ~44 characters), reply 1–3 sentences (under ~190 characters). The chat window is a stand-in: restyle `chat()`; never use a real AI brand name or logo.

params.name: Prompt
params.default: Write a launch post for our new planner

params.name: Reply
params.default: Meet the planner your team will actually open. Northwind turns scattered tasks into one calm week, so you spend less time planning and more time shipping.

templates.name: Before and after
templates.summary: A grey half with twelve messy manual steps; an orange line wipes down into the white half and its one clean, checked line.
templates.agentHint: Contrast the old way with the product. Write each label as "KICKER: HEADLINE" (the part after the colon is the big line, 1–3 words). The twelve steps and the checked line are STEPS and RESULT in the file.

templates.name: Before and after
templates.summary: Twelve crooked manual steps fill the left half, a comet draws the split, and one checked result lands on the right.
templates.agentHint: Contrast the old way with the product in a landscape film. Write each label as "Kicker: Headline" (headline 1–3 words, under ~16 characters; [brackets] take the spectrum). The twelve steps and the result line are STEPS and the Result param; a full-frame explainer, not an overlay.

templates.name: Browser
templates.summary: A URL types into a glass pill; the camera pulls back to reveal it is the address bar of a browser window, and the page builds inside.
templates.agentHint: Open a website or web-app demo. Keep the URL short (under ~24 characters, no https://). The page is a stand-in: redraw `page()` (1400 × 764 below the bar) or draw a screenshot there; avoid real browser or brand UI.

templates.name: Morphing points
templates.summary: One outline morphs pill → track → wave → ring under each point in big kinetic type; earlier points settle into a list on the left.
templates.agentHint: Three to four short points for a talk, a pitch or a product walkthrough, one per line (each 1–3 words, under ~18 characters); a fifth point reuses the pill. The shapes read as write (a field), tune (a slider), pulse (a wave) and present (play), so order the points to match.

params.name: Points
params.default:
Write the plan
Tune the timeline
Track the pulse
Present it

templates.name: Callout
templates.summary: An orange ring focuses one element of a dark product screen, the rest dims, and a leader runs out to a printed label.
templates.agentHint: Point at one feature. Title 1–3 words ([brackets] mark orange words), detail one short sentence. Over a film picture (backdrop false) the whole frame dims around FOCUS and the label sits on a white panel; move FOCUS to the element in your picture.

params.name: Detail
params.default: Updates the moment your team does.

templates.name: Callout
templates.summary: A comet rings one element of a product window on a tilted plane, the rest dims, and a leader opens a glass label.
templates.agentHint: Point at one feature of a product window. Title 1–3 words ([brackets] take the spectrum), detail one short sentence. With backdrop false the window is skipped and the frame dims around FOCUS over your own picture; move FOCUS (a rect in the 1400 × 860 window) to your element, or redraw the window in `appUI`.

params.name: Detail
params.default: Updates the moment your team does.

templates.name: Highlight caption
templates.summary: One big caption line rises under a picture window; the marked words are swept orange and underlined by hand.
templates.agentHint: One statement of up to ~40 characters with the key words in [brackets]. Put assets/highlight.jpg in the project for the picture; with backdrop false the caption sits on a white panel over your own footage.

templates.name: Pop captions
templates.summary: Short-video captions: one or two words at a time pop into a white strip over the picture, the last group in orange.
templates.agentHint: Punchy spoken line of 2–8 short words; words of up to three letters ride with the next word. Put assets/pop.jpg in the project for the picture, or play it with backdrop false over your own footage (the strip carries the words).

templates.name: Stacked caption
templates.summary: Tall words stack up line by line at the margin beside a growing orange rule; the last line lands in orange.
templates.agentHint: A slogan of 2–5 very short lines (1 word each, up to ~6 letters), one per "\n". Put assets/stack.jpg in the project for the picture strip; with backdrop false the stack sits on a white panel.

templates.name: Speaker subtitle
templates.summary: A spoken line rises in white over a dark picture window, with the speaker named behind a short orange rule.
templates.agentHint: Interview or founder quote: one sentence up to ~60 characters (wraps to two lines) and a "Name · Role" line. Put assets/speaker.jpg in the project for the picture; with backdrop false it draws its own scrim over your footage.

params.name: Subtitle
params.default: We built Northwind for teams that ship.

templates.name: Wide subtitle
templates.summary: A subtitle sharpens in over the picture on a soft scrim, a short spectrum underline draws, and the speaker follows.
templates.agentHint: Subtitle or pull quote over footage in a landscape film: one sentence (wraps to two lines past ~45 characters) and a speaker line. Play it with `backdrop: false` over your own picture; the product screen underneath is only a stand-in.

params.name: Subtitle
params.default: We built Northwind for teams that ship.

templates.name: Word captions
templates.summary: A line opens into a picture window; below it the subtitles build word by word and each key word is swept in orange.
templates.agentHint: Spoken subtitles for a voice-over: 2–3 lines of up to ~24 characters, one per "\n"; mark key words with [brackets] (default: the last word of each line). Put assets/caption.jpg in the project for the picture, or play it with backdrop false over your own footage.

params.name: Caption
params.default:
We built Northwind
for teams that ship
without the busywork

templates.name: Chapter title
templates.summary: A falling comet leaves a thin spectrum line; a huge spectrum chapter number and the title sharpen in on either side.
templates.agentHint: Section divider for a talk, a course or a long demo: number 1–3 characters, title under ~28 characters, subtitle under ~50. Long titles shrink to fit. Neon or night reads best.

params.name: Subtitle
params.default: How three teams agree on goals in one afternoon

templates.name: Click zoom
templates.summary: A big cursor clicks a button in a dark product window, the camera pushes in on it and an orange label names it.
templates.agentHint: Highlight one button or control. Label 2–5 words. The editor in the window is a stand-in: redraw `editor` with the real screen and move BTN to the control (keep it in the top half so the leader stays short).

templates.name: Call to action
templates.summary: A paper sheet rises over the last picture; the call to action rises with a soft ring, and a search field types the name and is tapped.
templates.agentHint: Last 3–4 s of a post: a call to action of 1–3 short words (mark one with [brackets]) and a name to search for, under ~16 characters. The picture above the sheet is a stand-in: put assets/endcard.jpg in the project, or play the template with backdrop: false over your own last shot.

templates.name: Website end card
templates.summary: The headline sharpens in, a light arc draws a pill round the web address, and a cursor clicks the button beside a QR card.
templates.agentHint: Closing call to action of a landscape film or a talk: a headline under ~28 characters, an address under ~24 and a button label of 1–3 words. The QR pattern is a stand-in that does not scan: replace the modules in `qrCard()` with your real code image (load it in `setup`, draw it into the same square).

templates.name: Desktop follow
templates.summary: A window opens onto a wide desktop app; the camera follows the cursor and pushes in on each of two clicks.
templates.agentHint: Show a two-click desktop flow in a portrait post. Label 2–5 words, [brackets] mark the orange words. The app is a stand-in 1440 × 1000 dashboard: redraw `app` with the real product and move CLICKS to its targets (the camera follows them).

templates.name: Device stack
templates.summary: A flat laptop and a phone rise out of an orange rule in turn, both showing the same product counting up in step.
templates.agentHint: Say the product works everywhere. Title 2–4 words ([brackets] mark orange words), detail one short line. Both screens come from `product` (landscape and portrait layouts of one stand-in dashboard): redraw it, or draw screenshots into the two screen rects.

templates.name: Feature grid
templates.summary: Quiet glass cards rise into a grid, then a comet runs around each in turn and lights it up in the spectrum.
templates.agentHint: Show what a product does in one frame: 3–6 features, one per line as "Name: detail" (name 1–3 words, detail under ~38 characters), headline under ~32 characters with [brackets] for the spectrum. Draw your own icons in `icon()` (one per card, by index).

params.name: Features
params.default:
Shared plans: One calm view of the week
Live reports: Numbers that update themselves
Goals: Progress the whole team can see
Team spaces: Every project in one place
Gentle alerts: Only what needs you today
Insights: Patterns found for you

templates.name: Growth bars
templates.summary: Bars rise one by one in soft spectrum gradients, then a comet runs along the trend and leaves a point at the last value.
templates.agentHint: A single growth story (revenue, users, speed) in a landscape film or a talk. The twelve monthly values are constants in `DATA` and the end label in `LABEL`; keep the headline under ~34 characters. It is a mood chart, not an exact one: no axis values.

params.name: Headline
params.default: Revenue, three times in a year

templates.name: Impact headline
templates.summary: The page opens in orange, a quote mark drops and three tall lines rise letter by letter; one word is underlined.
templates.agentHint: First 3–4 s of a post. Up to three lines of 1–3 short words, uppercase reads best; mark one word with [brackets]. Not for sentences longer than ~25 characters.

templates.name: Number hook
templates.summary: One huge figure rolls into place digit by digit like an odometer, its unit rises in orange and a caption follows.
templates.agentHint: Open on a single striking figure (1–4 characters: "3", "24", "9.5") with a short unit and a one-line caption under 30 characters. For several figures use stat-count.

templates.name: Question hook
templates.summary: A question rises in tall lines, an orange block sweeps the key words, and a huge question mark rises into place beside it.
templates.agentHint: Opening 3–4 s that asks the viewer a pain-point question. Up to three short uppercase lines (≤ 14 characters each); mark the key words with [brackets]; the question mark is drawn for you.

templates.name: Laptop
templates.summary: A minimal laptop rises, its lid swings open on the hinge and the screen lights from a glow into the product, beside a kinetic title.
templates.agentHint: Show a desktop product in context. Title under ~26 characters; it breaks after a comma, and [bracketed] words (else the last line) take the spectrum. The screen is a stand-in: redraw `screen()` or draw a 1400 × 860 screenshot into it.

templates.name: Logo and tagline
templates.summary: The mark builds stroke by stroke, the wordmark opens out of its centre as its spacing closes, and a tagline rises under a rule.
templates.agentHint: Closing logo of a 9:16 post. Brand 1–2 words, tagline under ~28 characters with one [marked] phrase. The N mark is a fictional stand-in: redraw `mark()` with your own logo as two or three flat strokes that grow in order.

templates.name: Logo and tagline
templates.summary: A point of light glides in and traces the mark, the stroke fills, the wordmark rises in letter by letter and the tagline sharpens below.
templates.agentHint: Closing logo of a landscape film. Brand 1–2 words, tagline under ~40 characters. The mark is a fictional stand-in: redraw `markPath()` (a centre line, traced then filled) and `ribbon()` with your own logo, keeping the trace → fill → letters order. Night or neon reads best.

templates.name: Logo wall
templates.summary: Partner names as glass chips with coloured dots float out of a soft light and settle into a loose grid under the headline.
templates.agentHint: Social proof in a landscape film or a talk. The twelve names are fictional stand-ins in `NAMES`: replace them with real customers you may name (or draw their logos inside the chips, keeping the chip and dot). The first number in the headline takes the spectrum.

templates.name: Multi-window
templates.summary: Three windows of one board stand in depth; a card moves in the first and a comet of light carries the change to the others in turn.
templates.agentHint: Real-time sync or collaboration. Title under ~28 characters; [bracketed] words (else the last word) take the spectrum. The board is a stand-in: rename the columns and cards in `COLS`, or redraw `board()`.

templates.name: Wide lower third
templates.summary: A comet draws a line, the name sharpens in above it as the light passes, the role follows; it exits into a dot.
templates.agentHint: Name and role over an interview or talking-head shot in a landscape film. Name 1–3 words, role under ~40 characters. Play it with `backdrop: false` over your footage; the soft-focus speaker underneath is only a stand-in.

templates.name: Phone recording
templates.summary: A flat black phone rises out of an orange rule under a tall title, and a touch checks off one task on its screen.
templates.agentHint: Show a mobile app in use. Title 2–4 words. The screen is a stand-in task list: put assets/screen.jpg (portrait, about 9:19) in the project to show a real recording frame, or redraw `phoneScreen`; the tap lands on the second row (TAP_ROW).

templates.name: Product hero
templates.summary: The name sharpens out of a spectrum blur, two pills land, and the product window swings in on a tilted plane.
templates.agentHint: Opening of a landing-page loop, Product Hunt or YouTube demo. Name 1–2 words, tagline under ~40 characters, button labels 1–3 words. The window is a stand-in: redraw it in `appUI` or draw a screenshot into the same 1400 × 860 card.

params.name: Tagline
params.default: Your whole week in one calm view.

templates.name: Vertical push
templates.summary: The next picture pushes the last one up out of frame, with a page gap and an orange leading edge between them; its title rises in.
templates.agentHint: Between two full-frame pictures or screens of a 9:16 film. Titles 1–4 words. The pictures are stand-in product screens: put assets/from.jpg and assets/to.jpg in the project (or redraw `picture`) so the push carries your own last and next shot.

templates.name: Push transition
templates.summary: An edge of spectrum light wipes right to left: the old picture is pushed away, the new one slides in and holds.
templates.agentHint: Cut between two landscape shots. The pictures are stand-ins: draw the outgoing shot in `pictureA` and the incoming one in `pictureB` (each is already offset). With backdrop false only the light edge and its shade are drawn. Titles under ~30 characters; the template ends on picture B, so the next shot starts from it.

templates.name: Quote pill
templates.summary: A light arc draws a wide neon pill, the quote types itself inside, and the attribution sharpens in below.
templates.agentHint: One-sentence quote or principle for a talk, a launch film or a testimonial: under ~60 characters reads on one line, up to ~120 wraps to two. Leave the quote marks out; the template adds them. Neon or night reads best.

params.name: Quote
params.default: The best plan is the one your whole team can see.

templates.name: Review carousel
templates.summary: Three reviews swipe past like a carousel, each with a big orange quote mark, the quote, a rule and the reviewer.
templates.agentHint: Social proof for a post: three reviews, one per line as "quote | name | role", quotes up to ~70 characters. Fictional people by default; use real reviews only with permission.

params.name: Reviews (quote | name | role)
params.default:
We cut weekly planning from two hours to twenty minutes. | Priya Nair | Head of Operations, Fernhill
Everyone sees the same plan now. Our stand-ups got shorter overnight. | Tom Okafor | Engineering Lead, Brightline
The first tool our whole team opened without being asked. | Lena Vogel | Product Manager, Harbor & Co.

templates.name: Numbers table
templates.summary: Three figures count up in an editorial table, each row drawn in under a thin rule with its label in caps.
templates.agentHint: Three key figures with short labels, one per line as "value | label" (a unit or suffix may follow the value: "4.9/5", "3 MIN"). Values up to 6 digits, labels under ~20 characters; the headline is one line of up to ~22 characters.

params.name: Figures (value | label)
params.default:
12,480 | Teams
4.9/5 | Average rating
3 MIN | To first film

templates.name: Wide numbers
templates.summary: Three numbers count up in a row in kinetic type, each landing on a short spectrum line with its label.
templates.agentHint: Traction or results in a landscape film or a talk. Figures are the `stats` param, one "value | label" per line ("4.9/5", "3 min": the text after the number is its unit): keep three, labels under ~18 characters, values up to six digits. Digits sit in fixed slots, so numbers do not jitter while they count.

params.name: Figures (value | label)
params.default:
12,480 | teams
4.9 | average rating
3 min | to first film

templates.name: Terminal
templates.summary: A light traces a terminal window into a neon rim; a command types, output lines tick off and the success line lands in the spectrum.
templates.agentHint: CLI, SDK or developer-tool launch. One command under ~34 characters. Output and success copy live in `OUTPUT` and `SUCCESS`; keep them to four short lines and one line. Neon ground reads best.

templates.name: Three steps
templates.summary: A line opens into a window and three step cards swipe through it like a carousel, each with its title above.
templates.agentHint: Explain a 3-step flow. Step titles 2–4 words, details one short line. The window shows a stand-in screen: put assets/step-1.jpg … step-3.jpg in the project (or redraw `screen`) to show the real product.

params.name: Details (one per line)
params.default:
Drop in your product page.
Choose the look and the pace.
MP4, ready to post.

templates.name: Wide headline
templates.summary: A comet of light runs in under the headline and writes its second line as it passes, then rests as a point.
templates.agentHint: Opening statement for a landing page, YouTube or a talk: two short lines (under ~26 characters each), the [bracketed] words in the spectrum. Night or neon ground reads best.

templates.name: Typed input
templates.summary: A flat input box draws itself, a query types behind an orange caret, send presses and three results rise below.
templates.agentHint: Show a prompt or search being typed and answered. Query up to ~60 characters (two lines). The three result rows are stand-ins in RESULTS: replace them with what the real product returns.

params.name: Query
params.default: Make a 30-second launch film for Northwind
